finding: Public owned batch receipt confirmation returned InvalidArgument for a count mismatch even after the query had already recorded a failure.
fix: For count/queue mismatch and envelope-required rejection, return existing query first error when present; preserve ordinary retryable protocol rejection without one.

red.observation: Prior QuotaExceeded was masked; test stopped at first case.

final.coverage: Prior QuotaExceeded and WorkerLost full fields; producer-envelope rejection.

final_regression.coverage: No prior failure retains mismatch error, correct count can be retried; retained bytes remain charged.

note: Test was expanded after red; green/regression are retained earlier runs. Final source hashes were stable for listed files only.
limitations: Synthetic in-process queue; no full concurrency, production IPC, cross-platform or performance qualification.
